description: Wait for a popup opened by your last navigate, click, fill, scroll or evaluate, even one that has already opened, and return its page_id. In a supervised session the popup becomes current. In other sessions, call switch_page or pass page_id. A popup Rove blocks answers popup-blocked at once instead of waiting. After a human returns control, a popup they opened counts; pass after_seq to wait for a newer one.

after_seq.description: Wait for a popup after this page event seq, such as an earlier result's page_events_seq_start.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait, in milliseconds. Default: 10000; maximum 30000.

name: wait_for_popup
